cat(a)log repo

Official repository for cat(a)log — the local-first catalog for foster cats. Add this repo to your F-Droid client to get updates.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://paxel.github.io/catlog/fdroid/repo
